NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/service-provider · @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow · 原评审：未解决

⌄

createServiceToken 返回 Object.freeze({name})，容器以该对象身份为 Map 键；createWorkflowRunServices 只是把应用 resolver 原样转发。因此任何在 artifact 内重建或无法导入原文的 token 都无法命中，插件未提供跨 artifact 的受支持解析通道。

实际影响
Run 模块无法按 Skill 推荐方式访问应用服务，只能靠应用侧字符串 token 绕行，增加隐式耦合与踩坑成本。
建议改法
为 Workflow Run 提供受支持的跨边界服务获取方式，例如按名称解析的注册表、注入所需服务，或在加载时绑定声明。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
Run 模块在 artifact 内尝试解析应用服务 token。
应有能力 / 行为
存在受支持的机制让 Run 模块拿到应用容器中的服务。
实际观察
token 身份跨 artifact 复制失配，导入原文又不可行，解析必然失败。
应用绕行与代价
应用把服务暴露为字符串 token 并注册别名，Run 模块用该字符串经 resolver 解析。
改进后的验收标准
Run 模块无需导入服务包或重建 token 即可解析到应用服务。

createServiceToken 返回 Object.freeze({ name }) 身份对象；同名 token 不相等。

const serviceTokenType = Symbol('service-token-type');
export function createServiceToken(name) {
    if (!name.trim()) {
        throw new Error('Service token name must not be empty.');
    }
    return Object.freeze({ name });
}
packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/container.js:1–56E7

ServiceContainer.bindings 是 Map，以 token 对象身份为键做 instance/singleton/has/resolve。

export class ServiceContainer {
    bindings = new Map();
    resolving = [];
    instance(token, value) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory: () => value,
            instance: value,
            state: 'created',
        });
    }
    singleton(token, factory) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory,
            instance: undefined,
            state: 'pending',
        });
    }
    has(token) {
        return this.bindings.has(token);
    }
    resolve(token) {
        const binding = this.bindings.get(token);
        if (!binding) {
            throw new Error(`Service "${token.name}" is not registered.`);
        }
        if (binding.state === 'created') {
            return binding.instance;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'failed') {
            throw binding.error;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'creating') {
            const cycle = [...this.resolving, token]
                .map((item) => item.name)
                .join(' -> ');
            throw new Error(`Circular service dependency detected: ${cycle}.`);
        }
        binding.state = 'creating';
        this.resolving.push(token);
        try {
            const value = binding.factory(this);
            binding.instance = value;
            binding.state = 'created';
            return value;
        }
        catch (error) {
            binding.error = error;
            binding.state = 'failed';
            throw error;
        }
        finally {
            this.resolving.pop();
        }
    }
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/engine/run-services.js:1–12E8

createWorkflowRunServices 返回冻结的 { has, resolve }，直接转发到应用 resolver，未做名称级或 artifact 级适配。

/** Hide the mutable application container behind the run-module contract. */
export function createWorkflowRunServices(resolver) {
    const services = {
        has(token) {
            return resolver.has(token);
        },
        resolve(token) {
            return resolver.resolve(token);
        },
    };
    return Object.freeze(services);
}
app/server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/contracts.ts:32–64E9

修后的 Run 契约为自包含模块，只导入本地类型；用字符串 token serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken 跨 artifact 边界，注释说明 artifact 可能位于 node_modules 之外。

/**
 * The application-owned steps the three Run nodes call.
 *
 * This indirection exists because the Run modules are copied into an isolated
 * Artifact store in production. The store can live outside the application's
 * `node_modules` — a deployment is free to put the private drive on its own
 * volume — so a Run module cannot import `@nocobase/db` or the notification
 * package as a value: the bare specifier would have no resolution path there.
 * This local, dependency-free module is the only thing they import, and they
 * reach the real work through the container token below.
 *
 * The implementation and the matching token live in
 * `server/providers/service-request-service.ts`.
 */
export interface ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps {
  registerAcceptance(
    input: ServiceRequestAcceptanceInput,
  ): Promise<ServiceRequestAcceptanceResult>;
  recordResult(input: ServiceRequestResultInput): Promise<void>;
  notifyAssignee(input: ServiceRequestAcceptanceInput): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Token the Run modules use to resolve {@link ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps}.
 *
 * It is a plain string on purpose. `createServiceToken` produces an object the
 * container matches by identity, and the Artifact holds its own copy of this
 * module, so two same-named objects would not match. A string compares by
 * value, so the provider's copy and the Artifact's copy resolve the same
 * binding. The provider spells the same string; a logic test keeps them equal.
 */
export const serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken =
  'service-request/workflow-steps' as unknown as ServiceToken<ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps>;

### [重要][能力缺口] 服务令牌的身份语义使其无法跨 Workflow Artifact 边界解析

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/service-provider`（评审时 0.0.2-beta.1）、`@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.28）

createServiceToken 返回 Object.freeze({name})，容器以该对象身份为 Map 键；createWorkflowRunServices 只是把应用 resolver 原样转发。因此任何在 artifact 内重建或无法导入原文的 token 都无法命中，插件未提供跨 artifact 的受支持解析通道。

**影响**：Run 模块无法按 Skill 推荐方式访问应用服务，只能靠应用侧字符串 token 绕行，增加隐式耦合与踩坑成本。

**建议改动**：为 Workflow Run 提供受支持的跨边界服务获取方式，例如按名称解析的注册表、注入所需服务，或在加载时绑定声明。

**验收标准**：Run 模块无需导入服务包或重建 token 即可解析到应用服务。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/token.js:1–7` — createServiceToken 返回 Object.freeze({ name }) 身份对象；同名 token 不相等。
- `packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/container.js:1–56` — ServiceContainer.bindings 是 Map，以 token 对象身份为键做 instance/singleton/has/resolve。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/engine/run-services.js:1–12` — createWorkflowRunServices 返回冻结的 { has, resolve }，直接转发到应用 resolver，未做名称级或 artifact 级适配。
- `app/server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/contracts.ts:32–64` — 修后的 Run 契约为自包含模块，只导入本地类型；用字符串 token serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken 跨 artifact 边界，注释说明 artifact 可能位于 node_modules 之外。

重要指引错误上游未复核
F1 · Workflow Skill 对 Run 模块导入解析与 token 导入的描述在生产 Artifact 中不成立

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow · @nocobase/service-provider · 原评审：未解决

⌄

dsl-authoring.md 称 Run 模块导入按应用普通运行时规则解析，并要求导入服务 owner 的原始公共 token；但生产运行时把工作流源码复制到 Artifact 目录并以原生 import() 加载，且强制模块只能解析到 artifact root 内。该目录不在 node_modules 下，裸说明符 @nocobase/db 无法解析；服务 token 又是身份对象，无法通过导入原文跨边界复用。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

Run 模块的导入按应用普通运行时依赖规则解析，且应导入服务 owner 的原始公共 token。

评审时 · 实际观察

生产 Artifact 无 node_modules，原生 import() 报 Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'；token 为冻结身份对象，导入原文无法跨 artifact 复用。

实际影响
按官方指引编写的 Run 模块在开发态通过、部署到生产即失败，且错误发生在首个 Run 节点，后续通知节点完全不执行，接口返回 502。
建议改法
在 Skill 中明确 Run 模块必须自包含、不得裸导入 node_modules 依赖，并给出跨边界访问应用服务的受支持模式（如字符串键 resolver 转发或运行时依赖注入），与 Artifact 加载实现保持一致。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
在 server/workflows 下用 RunInstruction 编写依赖 @nocobase/db 等包或导入服务 token 的 Run 模块，并以生产模式触发该工作流。
应有能力 / 行为
按 Skill 指引编写的 Run 模块在生产也能解析依赖并访问应用服务，或在 Skill 中提前给出可行约束。
实际观察
生产 Artifact 以原生 import() 加载隔离副本，裸导入报 Cannot find package；工作流首节点 Error，接口 502。
应用绕行与代价
Run 模块只导入本目录内的本地模块，服务访问改用字符串服务 token，经只读 services resolver 转发到应用服务。
改进后的验收标准
生产模式下触发工作流，Run 节点成功执行且能通过 resolver 调用数据库与通知服务，接口不返回 502。

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/dsl-authoring.md:213–213E4

Skill 明示：“Run modules are compiled by the application's normal server build, so their imports must resolve under that build's ordinary TypeScript and runtime dependency rules.”

The comments are intentional integration seams; replace them with application-specific typed service calls. Run modules are compiled by the application's normal server build, so their imports must resolve under that build's ordinary TypeScript and runtime dependency rules.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/dsl-authoring.md:386–386E5

Skill 要求：services 是只读 has/resolve 解析器，“import each service owner's original public token and do not recreate a same-named token.”

The processor leaves the node `PENDING` and yields before executing its module in the background. Completion saves the result and resumes the workflow; downstream nodes run only after completion. This is process-local asynchronous execution, not a durable job or a separate worker thread. The public function receives `args: unknown` and options with exactly `services`, `signal`, and `logger`. `services` is a read-only application service resolver with `has(token)` and `resolve(token)`: import each service owner's original public token and do not recreate a same-named token. The resolver cannot register or replace application services. `signal` is the current Workflow abort signal, and `logger` is already bound to the current Workflow execution context. The function returns/awaits an unknown value, but runtime accepts only JSON-storable results. `undefined` becomes `null`; BigInt, functions, symbols, non-finite numbers, circular values, and class instances fail. A return like `{ status: 'failed' }` is ordinary successful business data. Throw to mark execution error. Scripts cannot choose branches, suspend, resume, or drive the processor state machine.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/instructions/run/instruction.js:284–330E1

loadRunModule 强制 Run 模块经 realpath 解析在 artifact root 之内，然后用原生 import() 加载该文件；bare 说明符按该文件位置解析。

async function loadRunModule(workflowResourceRoot, specifier, nodeKey) {
    if (!workflowResourceRoot) {
        throw new Error(`Run node "${nodeKey}" has no workflow resource root bound to it`);
    }
    const target = await resolveWorkflowModule(workflowResourceRoot, specifier);
    const cached = moduleCache.get(target);
    if (cached)
        return cached;
    const pending = importRunModule(target, specifier);
    moduleCache.set(target, pending);
    return pending;
}
function resolveInsideRoot(root, relativePath, specifier) {
    const target = path.resolve(root, relativePath);
    const relative = path.relative(root, target);
    if (!relative || relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
        throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" resolves outside its artifact`);
    }
    return target;
}
async function resolveWorkflowModule(root, specifier) {
    const base = resolveInsideRoot(root, specifier, specifier);
    for (const extension of ['.js', '.mjs', '.ts']) {
        const target = `${base}${extension}`;
        try {
            const realRoot = await fs.realpath(root);
            const realTarget = await fs.realpath(target);
            const relative = path.relative(realRoot, realTarget);
            if (!relative || relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
                throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" resolves outside its workflow resources`);
            }
            return realTarget;
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (error.code !== 'ENOENT')
                throw error;
        }
    }
    throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" was not found`);
}
async function importRunModule(target, specifier) {
    const loaded = (await import(__rewriteRelativeImportExtension(pathToFileURL(target).href)));
    if (typeof loaded.run !== 'function') {
        throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" must export a function named run`);
    }
    return { run: loaded.run };
}
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/loader/artifact-store.js:38–67E3

LocalWorkflowArtifactStore.commit 用 fs.cp 递归复制工作流源码目录到 artifact 目标目录，不注入 node_modules。

    async commit(workflowKey, digest, source) {
        await this.verifyDirectory(source, workflowKey, digest);
        const destination = this.artifactPath(workflowKey, digest);
        if (await exists(destination)) {
            await this.verifyDirectory(destination, workflowKey, digest);
            return;
        }
        await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(destination), { recursive: true });
        const temporary = `${destination}.tmp-${randomUUID()}`;
        try {
            await fs.cp(source, temporary, {
                recursive: true,
                errorOnExist: true,
                force: false,
            });
            await this.verifyDirectory(temporary, workflowKey, digest);
            try {
                await fs.rename(temporary, destination);
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (error.code !== 'EEXIST' &&
                    error.code !== 'ENOTEMPTY')
                    throw error;
                await this.verifyDirectory(destination, workflowKey, digest);
            }
        }
        finally {
            await fs.rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
    }

### [重要][指引错误] Workflow Skill 对 Run 模块导入解析与 token 导入的描述在生产 Artifact 中不成立

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.28）、`packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow`、`@nocobase/service-provider`（评审时 0.0.2-beta.1）

dsl-authoring.md 称 Run 模块导入按应用普通运行时规则解析，并要求导入服务 owner 的原始公共 token；但生产运行时把工作流源码复制到 Artifact 目录并以原生 import() 加载，且强制模块只能解析到 artifact root 内。该目录不在 node_modules 下，裸说明符 @nocobase/db 无法解析；服务 token 又是身份对象，无法通过导入原文跨边界复用。

**文档 / API 声称**：Run 模块的导入按应用普通运行时依赖规则解析，且应导入服务 owner 的原始公共 token。

**实际观察**：生产 Artifact 无 node_modules，原生 import() 报 Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'；token 为冻结身份对象，导入原文无法跨 artifact 复用。

**影响**：按官方指引编写的 Run 模块在开发态通过、部署到生产即失败，且错误发生在首个 Run 节点，后续通知节点完全不执行，接口返回 502。

**建议改动**：在 Skill 中明确 Run 模块必须自包含、不得裸导入 node_modules 依赖，并给出跨边界访问应用服务的受支持模式（如字符串键 resolver 转发或运行时依赖注入），与 Artifact 加载实现保持一致。

**验收标准**：生产模式下触发工作流，Run 节点成功执行且能通过 resolver 调用数据库与通知服务，接口不返回 502。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/dsl-authoring.md:213–213` — Skill 明示：“Run modules are compiled by the application's normal server build, so their imports must resolve under that build's ordinary TypeScript and runtime dependency rules.”
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/dsl-authoring.md:386–386` — Skill 要求：services 是只读 has/resolve 解析器，“import each service owner's original public token and do not recreate a same-named token.”
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/instructions/run/instruction.js:284–330` — loadRunModule 强制 Run 模块经 realpath 解析在 artifact root 之内，然后用原生 import() 加载该文件；bare 说明符按该文件位置解析。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/loader/artifact-store.js:38–67` — LocalWorkflowArtifactStore.commit 用 fs.cp 递归复制工作流源码目录到 artifact 目标目录，不注入 node_modules。
- `packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/token.js:1–7` — createServiceToken 返回 Object.freeze({ name }) 身份对象；同名 token 不相等。
- `artifacts/verify-2/browser-acceptance/report.json:1–25` — 生产浏览器验收失败：Accept 接口 502 SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_FAILED，节点 Register acceptance 报 Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'，run 状态 Error，收件箱为空。

> 来源：nb3-factory 独立搭建评审（口径 v2，源 Run 36329207021 / attempt 1）。尚未复核最新上游源码。
实现者过程与运行背景 · 5 个过程问题 / 1 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repair round 2: production-only 502 on service-request acceptance. `POST /api/service-requests/{1,2}/accept` returned SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_FAILED (run status -2) because the Workflow engine materializes a revision's Run modules into an isolated Artifact store, and the three Run modules imported `@nocobase/db` (and `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification/server`) as values. In production the store lives on the configured private drive outside the application's `node_modules`, so the bare specifier `@nocobase/db` could not resolve and the `Register acceptance` node errored, which stopped `Notify assignee` and left the assignee inbox empty. The run modules are now dependency-free: they import only a local `contracts.ts` (a `readRequestId` helper plus a plain-string service token), and the database/notification work moved into `ServiceRequestService` in `server/providers/service-request-service.ts`, registered under the same string token. A `vitest` logic test guards token equality and forbids bare value imports in the Run modules. Verified by importing the built Artifact from `/tmp` (outside `node_modules`): it resolves and calls the step service, while a bare-import module fails there with the original error shape. The dev-path server integration test still passes (29/29). Prior records are preserved below: Repair round 1: the single observed failure was the format gate. A stray double blank line committed in AGENTS.md (template/factory content between the 'Factory task termination' and '## Controlled failed-delivery smoke' sections) made `prettier . --check '!.github/**'` exit 1. Removed the extra blank line with `prettier --write`; the gate now passes. Prior implementation record (Issue #415 simplified service-request app verifying Workflow + persistent in-app notification collaboration) is preserved below: serviceRequests table via migration, idempotent seed with assignee account and two demo requests, source-managed acceptance workflow (register -> branch on urgency -> record result -> send persistent in-app message), a service + HTTP routes that wait for the workflow run to terminate, and three client pages (list/create, detail/accept, message center). Existing Notification/In-App channel and Workflow engine are reused; no custom message table, toast, or in-memory list.

问题 01 · 自动验证

format:check failed on AGENTS.md

本任务已处理

`pnpm format:check` (`prettier . --check '!.github/**'`) exited 1 with `[warn] AGENTS.md` / 'Code style issues found'. Every feature file reported '(unchanged)' and format:auto had exited 0, so only AGENTS.md was unformatted.

原因（实现者自述）
AGENTS.md committed at control SHA 4f50452 contains two consecutive blank lines between the 'Factory task termination' paragraph ending 'Preserve unknown causes and incomplete diagnoses.' and the '## Controlled failed-delivery smoke' heading. Prettier collapses consecutive blank lines to one. The defect is in template/factory-managed prose, not in the feature work, which is why no application change triggered it.
处理方式
Ran `pnpm exec prettier AGENTS.md --write`, which removed exactly one blank line (1 deletion, no content change). Re-ran the factory's exact command and it reports 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'. No factory control file (.github/, .npmrc, .gitmodules, config.yml) was touched and no validation was weakened.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 实现阶段

Workflow auto-enablement has no public non-HTTP API

本任务已处理

The source-managed acceptance workflow was registered but not enabled, so firing it would not run under the application's Workflow engine.

原因（实现者自述）
The Workflow plugin exposes enabling only through its management (settings) repository/HTTP layer; there is no public server-only enable contract for a source-managed workflow.
处理方式
The service-request provider emulates the management enable by updating the workflow record through the repository (updateMany on workflows), so the workflow is active once the server starts. Verified by the server-side integration test executing the real engine.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 实现阶段

Detail page cannot deep-link to a specific workflow run

未解决

The intended 'view execution record / steps and final result' link to a single run could not be offered from the detail page.

原因（实现者自述）
/settings/workflow/runs is a settings page guarded by settings:workflow manage (root only), so non-root supervisors and assignees cannot open it, and the task defines no per-role page grant for it.
处理方式
The detail page shows the final result and a localized hint that the step-by-step execution records live in the existing Workflow runs UI, instead of linking to a page the target roles cannot open. Accepted as a scope limitation of this small build; not a blocker to the requested collaboration flow.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 实现阶段

New pages use authz:'skip' because no per-role page grant is defined

未解决

The list, detail, and message-center routes could not be restricted to a product/settings page grant.

原因（实现者自述）
The task specifies only two test accounts and one assignee opening a request from an inbox message; it defines no page permissions, and the assignee must reach the detail page from the message center.
处理方式
Routes declare authz:'skip' while still requiring an authenticated session (auth:'required') and enforcing authorization on the server routes. Accepted for this verification-only build; a production system would add page grants and switch the routes to a page authz rule.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 自动验证

Production acceptance run fails: Run module cannot resolve @nocobase/db

本任务已处理

Clicking Accept made `POST /main/api/service-requests/{1,2}/accept` return 502 with `SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_FAILED` / `workflow run "N" finished with status -2`. Workflow execution records showed the `Register acceptance` node erroring: `Cannot find package '@nocobase/db' imported from .../workflows/service-request-acceptance/<hash>/server/register-acceptance.js`. The `Notify assignee` node never ran, so no in-app messages existed and the assignee's Messages center was empty.

原因（实现者自述）
The workflow Run modules imported application packages as values (`import { databaseManagerToken } from '@nocobase/db'`; notify-assignee also `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification/server`). In production the Workflow engine copies the revision's Run modules into an isolated Artifact store rooted at the configured `artifactDisk` (the private `drive` disk). The factory's generated runtime config points that private disk at an external verification directory outside the application's `node_modules`, so Node had no resolution path for those bare specifiers from the materialized Artifact (`LocalWorkflowArtifactStore`). The existing server integration test runs with `production: false`, where the workflow loads from the source package and `@nocobase/db` resolves, so it never exercised this path.
处理方式
Made the Run modules self-contained. Added `server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/contracts.ts`, a dependency-free module that exports a `readRequestId` helper, the `ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps` interface, and a plain-string token (`'service-request/workflow-steps'`) — a string rather than a `createServiceToken` object because the Artifact holds its own module copy and identity would not match. Moved the database and notification work into `ServiceRequestService` (`server/providers/service-request-service.ts`), which now implements the interface and is registered under the string token by the existing provider. The Run modules import only `./contracts.ts`. Added `tests/logic/service-request-workflow.test.ts`, which asserts the contract and provider tokens are equal and statically rejects bare value imports in the Run modules. Verified the built Artifact imported from `/tmp` (no `node_modules`) resolves and calls the step service, and that a bare `@nocobase/db` import fails there with the original `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` shape. `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit`, root `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files, the new test, and the full `tests/logic/app-server.test.ts` (29/29) all pass.
影响 / 代价：One repair round: investigation of the artifact store and drive config, server tsc + workflow artifact build, an isolated Artifact import check, and targeted typecheck/lint/format/tests.来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · factory

Format gate should run on template/factory-owned docs before publishing a control SHA

可自动化

The control SHA delivered to this task (4f50452) already contained the double blank line in AGENTS.md, so the verification format gate failed even though the implementation left every application file formatted. A format violation in framework-managed prose is indistinguishable, in the failure output, from one introduced by the application agent, and it consumed a repair attempt.

建议改动

Run `prettier . --check` (or at least `prettier AGENTS.md`/`README.MD`/docs) as part of the factory's own pre-publish checks for the template/control files, or whitelist framework-managed markdown from the application format gate so a template-authored formatting defect does not fail the application's verification.

来源：Agent · retro.json

需求 → 框架职责 → 推荐与实际接入

定义可执行的多节点业务工作流并按事件触发。直接支持
框架职责与业务边界
插件提供 defineWorkflow/RunInstruction/ConditionInstruction 生成 AST，WorkflowService 负责校验、落库、入队与触发。
推荐使用方式
在 server/workflows/<key> 下用 defineWorkflow 声明节点，RunInstruction.config.module 指向本工作流目录内实现文件。
Agent 实际使用

E1 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/instructions/run/instruction.js:284–330

loadRunModule 强制 Run 模块经 realpath 解析在 artifact root 之内，然后用原生 import() 加载该文件；bare 说明符按该文件位置解析。

async function loadRunModule(workflowResourceRoot, specifier, nodeKey) {
    if (!workflowResourceRoot) {
        throw new Error(`Run node "${nodeKey}" has no workflow resource root bound to it`);
    }
    const target = await resolveWorkflowModule(workflowResourceRoot, specifier);
    const cached = moduleCache.get(target);
    if (cached)
        return cached;
    const pending = importRunModule(target, specifier);
    moduleCache.set(target, pending);
    return pending;
}
function resolveInsideRoot(root, relativePath, specifier) {
    const target = path.resolve(root, relativePath);
    const relative = path.relative(root, target);
    if (!relative || relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
        throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" resolves outside its artifact`);
    }
    return target;
}
async function resolveWorkflowModule(root, specifier) {
    const base = resolveInsideRoot(root, specifier, specifier);
    for (const extension of ['.js', '.mjs', '.ts']) {
        const target = `${base}${extension}`;
        try {
            const realRoot = await fs.realpath(root);
            const realTarget = await fs.realpath(target);
            const relative = path.relative(realRoot, realTarget);
            if (!relative || relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
                throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" resolves outside its workflow resources`);
            }
            return realTarget;
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (error.code !== 'ENOENT')
                throw error;
        }
    }
    throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" was not found`);
}
async function importRunModule(target, specifier) {
    const loaded = (await import(__rewriteRelativeImportExtension(pathToFileURL(target).href)));
    if (typeof loaded.run !== 'function') {
        throw new Error(`Run module "${specifier}" must export a function named run`);
    }
    return { run: loaded.run };
}

E3 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/loader/artifact-store.js:38–67

LocalWorkflowArtifactStore.commit 用 fs.cp 递归复制工作流源码目录到 artifact 目标目录，不注入 node_modules。

    async commit(workflowKey, digest, source) {
        await this.verifyDirectory(source, workflowKey, digest);
        const destination = this.artifactPath(workflowKey, digest);
        if (await exists(destination)) {
            await this.verifyDirectory(destination, workflowKey, digest);
            return;
        }
        await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(destination), { recursive: true });
        const temporary = `${destination}.tmp-${randomUUID()}`;
        try {
            await fs.cp(source, temporary, {
                recursive: true,
                errorOnExist: true,
                force: false,
            });
            await this.verifyDirectory(temporary, workflowKey, digest);
            try {
                await fs.rename(temporary, destination);
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (error.code !== 'EEXIST' &&
                    error.code !== 'ENOTEMPTY')
                    throw error;
                await this.verifyDirectory(destination, workflowKey, digest);
            }
        }
        finally {
            await fs.rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
    }

E5 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/dsl-authoring.md:386–386

Skill 要求：services 是只读 has/resolve 解析器，“import each service owner's original public token and do not recreate a same-named token.”

The processor leaves the node `PENDING` and yields before executing its module in the background. Completion saves the result and resumes the workflow; downstream nodes run only after completion. This is process-local asynchronous execution, not a durable job or a separate worker thread. The public function receives `args: unknown` and options with exactly `services`, `signal`, and `logger`. `services` is a read-only application service resolver with `has(token)` and `resolve(token)`: import each service owner's original public token and do not recreate a same-named token. The resolver cannot register or replace application services. `signal` is the current Workflow abort signal, and `logger` is already bound to the current Workflow execution context. The function returns/awaits an unknown value, but runtime accepts only JSON-storable results. `undefined` becomes `null`; BigInt, functions, symbols, non-finite numbers, circular values, and class instances fail. A return like `{ status: 'failed' }` is ordinary successful business data. Throw to mark execution error. Scripts cannot choose branches, suspend, resume, or drive the processor state machine.

E7 · packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/container.js:1–56

ServiceContainer.bindings 是 Map，以 token 对象身份为键做 instance/singleton/has/resolve。

export class ServiceContainer {
    bindings = new Map();
    resolving = [];
    instance(token, value) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory: () => value,
            instance: value,
            state: 'created',
        });
    }
    singleton(token, factory) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory,
            instance: undefined,
            state: 'pending',
        });
    }
    has(token) {
        return this.bindings.has(token);
    }
    resolve(token) {
        const binding = this.bindings.get(token);
        if (!binding) {
            throw new Error(`Service "${token.name}" is not registered.`);
        }
        if (binding.state === 'created') {
            return binding.instance;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'failed') {
            throw binding.error;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'creating') {
            const cycle = [...this.resolving, token]
                .map((item) => item.name)
                .join(' -> ');
            throw new Error(`Circular service dependency detected: ${cycle}.`);
        }
        binding.state = 'creating';
        this.resolving.push(token);
        try {
            const value = binding.factory(this);
            binding.instance = value;
            binding.state = 'created';
            return value;
        }
        catch (error) {
            binding.error = error;
            binding.state = 'failed';
            throw error;
        }
        finally {
            this.resolving.pop();
        }
    }

/** Hide the mutable application container behind the run-module contract. */
export function createWorkflowRunServices(resolver) {
    const services = {
        has(token) {
            return resolver.has(token);
        },
        resolve(token) {
            return resolver.resolve(token);
        },
    };
    return Object.freeze(services);
}

E9 · app/server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/contracts.ts:32–64

修后的 Run 契约为自包含模块，只导入本地类型；用字符串 token serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken 跨 artifact 边界，注释说明 artifact 可能位于 node_modules 之外。

/**
 * The application-owned steps the three Run nodes call.
 *
 * This indirection exists because the Run modules are copied into an isolated
 * Artifact store in production. The store can live outside the application's
 * `node_modules` — a deployment is free to put the private drive on its own
 * volume — so a Run module cannot import `@nocobase/db` or the notification
 * package as a value: the bare specifier would have no resolution path there.
 * This local, dependency-free module is the only thing they import, and they
 * reach the real work through the container token below.
 *
 * The implementation and the matching token live in
 * `server/providers/service-request-service.ts`.
 */
export interface ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps {
  registerAcceptance(
    input: ServiceRequestAcceptanceInput,
  ): Promise<ServiceRequestAcceptanceResult>;
  recordResult(input: ServiceRequestResultInput): Promise<void>;
  notifyAssignee(input: ServiceRequestAcceptanceInput): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Token the Run modules use to resolve {@link ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps}.
 *
 * It is a plain string on purpose. `createServiceToken` produces an object the
 * container matches by identity, and the Artifact holds its own copy of this
 * module, so two same-named objects would not match. A string compares by
 * value, so the provider's copy and the Artifact's copy resolve the same
 * binding. The provider spells the same string; a logic test keeps them equal.
 */
export const serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken =
  'service-request/workflow-steps' as unknown as ServiceToken<ServiceRequestWorkflowSteps>;

E10 · app/server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/notify-assignee.ts:1–27

Run 模块仅导入本地 contracts 并调用注入 service，不导入通知包本身。

import type {
  WorkflowRunFunction,
  WorkflowRunJsonValue,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow';
import {
  readRequestId,
  serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken,
} from './contracts.ts';

/**
 * Ask the application to send one persistent in-app message to the request
 * assignee. The message text and the idempotency key live in the step service,
 * because this module is copied into an isolated Artifact store in production
 * and cannot import the notification package from there; see `./contracts.ts`.
 */
export const run: WorkflowRunFunction = async (
  rawArgs,
  options,
): Promise<WorkflowRunJsonValue> => {
  options.signal.throwIfAborted();
  const requestId = readRequestId(rawArgs);
  const steps = options.services.resolve(serviceRequestWorkflowStepsToken);
  await steps.notifyAssignee({ requestId });
  options.logger.info('Service request assignee notified', { requestId });
  return null;
};

        const channels = Object.keys(input.messages);
        if (channels.length === 0)
            throw new Error('At least one notification message is required.');
        const message = {};

            await this.ensureRuntime(channel);
            const validated = this.channelManager.validateMessage(channel, input.messages[channel]);
            message[channel] = validated.message;
            const [provider] = this.channelManager.providerIdentities(channel);
            for (const recipient of validated.recipients)

            ...input,
            messages: message,
        });

E17 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-notification/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification/references/sending-notifications.md:1–30

Skill 给出 notificationServiceToken.send 的标准调用：idempotencyKey、source、messages 中 inbox 频道含 to/title/body/target。

# Sending Notifications

Resolve `notificationServiceToken` from the shared application container. Select configured Channel names through `messages`; each value is the complete message for its Provider.

```ts
const notification = app.container.resolve(notificationServiceToken);
await notification.send({
  idempotencyKey: 'approval-123',
  source: { type: 'approval', referenceId: '123' },
  messages: {
    'system-email': {
      to: ['customer@example.com', 'reviewer@example.com'],
      subject: 'Approval result',
      html: '<p>Approved</p>',
    },
    'ops-feishu': {
      text: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'url', url: 'https://example.com/main/approvals/123' },
    },
    inbox: {
      to: '123',
      title: 'Approval result',
      body: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'route', path: '/approvals/123' },
    },
  },
});
```

Email requires a native email address or a non-empty readonly array of addresses, a subject, and text or HTML. Each address receives a separate email and retries independently. In-app messages require application user IDs in the same string/array shape, title, and body; final delivery checks that each user still exists. Webhook messages forbid `to`. The service does not resolve application users into email addresses or phone numbers and never defaults to the current user.

E18 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification-in-app/SKILL.md:56–78

in-app Skill 要求 HTTP 状态权威、用 useApiClient 读写收件箱、保留服务端按用户过滤，不得用客户端传入的用户覆盖。

1. Read [Inbox Integration Contract](references/inbox-integration.md) for package requirements, public surfaces, and runtime semantics.
2. Inspect the target application's Server plugin list, Client composition, authentication setup, `api.baseURL`, `api.realtimeURL`, and installed package versions.
3. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification` before `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/server` when the application needs the `in-app` Channel contribution.
4. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the Client composition root. In a development build, verify the page at `/dev/notification-in-app` relative to the App base path.
5. In React components and custom Hooks, use `useApiClient()` from `@nocobase/app-client` for inbox reads and mutations, and `useService(realtimeClientToken)` for subscriptions. Outside React, resolve the corresponding tokens from the application's services or receive the clients explicitly. Do not reconstruct `/api` from the browser location or Portal base.
6. Keep HTTP state authoritative. On a validated `inbox.changed` event, realtime connection open, or window focus, trigger a bounded HTTP refetch.
7. Use the public `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime` entry for shared topic or event types; do not import Server internals.
8. Test allowed and denied users, CSRF-protected mutations, pagination, custom API hosts, realtime invalidation, reconnect recovery, and Dev Route registration.
9. Run lint, typecheck, tests, and build for the plugin and affected application.

# Reference Loading Map

| Reference                                                     | Use When                                                                            | Notes                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| [Inbox Integration Contract](references/inbox-integration.md) | integrating, customizing, verifying, or diagnosing the inbox                        | Required packages, routes, events, ownership, tests |
| [Plugin README](../../README.md)                              | confirming Server registration, route behavior, pagination, CSRF, or user isolation | Package-level public contract                       |

# Safety Gate

- Inbox mutations affect a real user's durable notification state. Confirm the target user/session before mutation testing outside an isolated test application.
- Never log session cookies, CSRF tokens, notification bodies, or recipient identifiers.
- Use authenticated routes and preserve the Server's per-user filters; do not add a client-supplied user override.
- A realtime event is only an invalidation signal. Never render its payload as authoritative inbox content.

import { defineMigration, type MigrationDefinition } from '@nocobase/db';

const migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({
  name: '202609020001_create_orders',

  async up({ builder }) {
    await builder.createCollection('orders', (collection) => {
      collection.increments('id');
      collection.string('orderNo', { length: 64, nullable: false });
      collection.string('status', { length: 32, nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.unique('orderNo');
      collection.index('status');
    });
  },

  async down({ builder }) {
    await builder.dropCollection('orders');
  },
});

export default migration;
```

```ts
// database/main/seeds/202609030002_default_order_statuses.ts
import { defineSeed } from '@nocobase/db';

export default defineSeed({
  name: '202609030002_default_order_statuses',

  async run({ repository }) {
    await repository('orderStatuses').upsertOne({
      filter: { code: 'draft' },
      create: { code: 'draft', title: 'Draft' },
      update: { title: 'Draft' },
    });
  },
});
```

Apply both with `pnpm nocobase db apply`, adding `--connection <name>` for a non-default connection or `--all` for every managed one.

Each context carries its own tools, and which one to use is not a free choice — see [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query). In short: a migration works through `builder` and `query`, and a seed writes through `repository`.

export function defineAppRoutes(routes) {
    return Object.freeze({
        parent: 'app',
        routes: freezeNavigationRoutes(routes),
    });
}
function freezeNavigationRoutes(routes) {
    return Object.freeze(routes.map((route) => Object.freeze({
        ...route,
        ...(route.navigation
            ? { navigation: Object.freeze({ ...route.navigation }) }
            : {}),
        ...(route.children
            ? { children: freezeNavigationRoutes(route.children) }
            : {}),
    })));
}
export function defineSettingsRoutes(routes) {
    return Object.freeze({
        parent: 'settings',
        routes: freezeNavigationRoutes(routes),
    });
}

/**
 * The single business table for the simplified service-request flow.
 *
 * `assigneeId` stores a `user.id` (a string in the authentication schema). The

 * writes by identity, and the demo does not need relation traversal.

  name: '202609250001_create_service_requests',

      collection.increments('id');
      collection.string('title', { length: 256 }).notNull();
      collection.boolean('urgent').notNull().defaultTo(false);
      collection.string('assigneeId', { length: 64 }).notNull();
      collection
        .string('status', { length: 32 })
        .notNull()
        .defaultTo('pending');
      // `normal` or `urgent` once the acceptance workflow has run; null while
      // the request is still pending.
      collection.string('result', { length: 32 }).nullable();
      collection.datetime('acceptedAt').nullable();
      collection.datetime('createdAt').notNull();
      collection.index('status', { name: 'idx_service_requests_status' });
      collection.index('assigneeId', { name: 'idx_service_requests_assignee' });
    });
  },
  async down({ builder }) {
    await builder.dropCollection('serviceRequests');
  },
});

Read this before running any agent-browser commands. Covers the snapshot-and-ref workflow, navigating pages, interacting with elements (click, fill, type, select), extracting text and data, taking screenshots, managing tabs, handling forms and auth, waiting for content, running multiple browser sessions in parallel, and troubleshooting common failures. Use when the user asks to interact with a website, fill a form, click something, extract data, take a screenshot, log into a site, test a web app, or automate any browser task.\nallowed-tools: Bash(agent-browser:*), Bash(npx agent-browser:*)\n---\n\n# agent-browser core\n\nFast browser automation CLI for AI agents. Chrome/Chromium via CDP, no Playwright or Puppeteer dependency. Accessibility-tree snapshots with compact `@eN` refs let agents interact with pages in ~200-400 tokens instead of parsing raw HTML.\n\nMost normal web tasks (navigate, read, click, fill, extract, screenshot) are covered here. Load a specialized skill when the task falls outside browser web pages — see [When to load another skill](#when-to-load-another-skill).\n\n## The core loop\n\n```bash\nagent-browser open <url>        # 1. Open a page\nagent-browser snapshot -i       # 2. See what's on it (interactive elements only)\nagent-browser click @e3         # 3. Act on refs from the snapshot\nagent-browser snapshot -i       # 4. Re-snapshot after any page change\n```\n\nRefs (`@e1`, `@e2`, ...) are assigned fresh on every snapshot. They become **stale the moment the page changes** — after clicks that navigate, form submits, dynamic re-renders, dialog opens. Always re-snapshot before your next ref interaction.\n\n## Always use your own session\n\nBefore your first command, set a named session for the whole task:\n\n```bash\nexport AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=\"$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task)\"\n```\n\nThe default (unnamed) session is a single shared browser: it is shared with every other agent on the machine and it persists across conversations, so working in it can hijack another agent's page mid-task or navigate away from something the human left open. Every example below assumes a named session is active. See [Run multiple browsers in parallel](#run-multiple-browsers-in-parallel) and `references/session-management.md`.\n\n## Quickstart\n\n```bash\n# Install once\nnpm i -g agent-browser && agent-browser install\n\n# Linux hosts can install required browser libraries too\nagent-browser install --with-deps\n\n# Take a screenshot of a page\nagent-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser screenshot home.png\nagent-browser close\n\n# Search, click a result, and capture it\nagent-browser open https://duckduckgo.com\nagent-browser snapshot -i                      # find the search box ref\nagent-browser fill @e1 \"agent-browser cli\"\nagent-browser press Enter\nagent-browser wait --load networkidle\nagent-browser snapshot -i                      # refs now reflect results\nagent-browser click @e5                        # click a result\nagent-browser screenshot result.png\n```\n\nThe browser stays running across commands so these feel like a single session. By default, an inactive daemon saves configured restore state, closes its headless browser, and exits after one hour; the next command starts it again. Without `--restore` or another restore key, shutdown discards transient browser state and open tabs. Dashboard mouse, keyboard, and touch input count as activity. Headed browsers, Safari and iOS WebDriver sessions, and user-attached browsers are exempt from the default; provider-owned cloud browsers are not. Use `--idle-timeout <time>` or `AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` to tune the timeout, and use `0` to disable it. Still run `agent-browser close` (or `close --all`) when you're done.\n\n## MCP integration\n\nFor tools that support Model Context Protocol servers, start the stdio server:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser mcp\nagent-browser mcp --tools all\nagent-browser mcp --tools core,network,react\n```\n\nConfigure the MCP client to launch `agent-browser` with `[\"mcp\"]`. The server defaults to MCP protocol 2025-11-25 and accepts older supported client protocol versions during initialization. The default tools profile is `core`, which keeps MCP context small for everyday browser automation. Use `--tools all` for the full typed CLI parity surface, or combine profiles with commas, such as `--tools core,network,react`. Profiles are `core`, `network`, `state`, `debug`, `tabs`, `react`, `mobile`, and `all`; the `debug` profile includes accessibility audits, plugin registry, and command.run tools. Each tool accepts typed arguments plus `extraArgs` for advanced CLI flags and exact CLI parity. The common `allowedDomains` array maps to `--allowed-domains` and activates the same WebRTC containment and launch-mode restrictions, while `idleTimeout` maps to `--idle-timeout`. Tool discovery is paginated and includes read-only/open-world annotations so modern MCP clients can load the large typed surface incrementally. Use the tool `session` argument or `AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION` to isolate browser sessions.\n\n## eve agent integration\n\nFor eve agents, mount the `@agent-browser/eve` extension instead of hand-writing browser tools. It adds namespaced tools such as `browser__navigate`, `browser__snapshot`, `browser__click`, `browser__fill`, `browser__find`, and `browser__screenshot`, all backed by agent-browser running inside the eve sandbox. The sandbox bootstrap helpers (`installAgentBrowser`, `agentBrowserRevalidationKey`) ship with the same package under `@agent-browser/eve/sandbox`, so `agent/sandbox.ts` needs no extra dependency.\n\n## Reading a page\n\n```bash\nagent-browser snapshot                    # full tree (verbose)\nagent-browser snapshot -i                 # interactive elements only (preferred)\nagent-browser snapshot -i -u              # include href urls on links\nagent-browser snapshot -i -c              # compact (no empty structural nodes)\nagent-browser snapshot -i -d 3            # cap depth at 3 levels\nagent-browser snapshot -s \"#main\"         # scope to a CSS selector\nagent-browser snapshot -i --json          # machine-readable output\n```\n\nSnapshot output looks like:\n\n```\nPage: Example - Log in\nURL: https://example.com/login\n\n@e1 [heading] \"Log in\"\n@e2 [form]\n  @e3 [input type=\"email\"] placeholder=\"Email\"\n  @e4 [input type=\"password\"] placeholder=\"Password\"\n  @e5 [button type=\"submit\"] \"Continue\"\n  @e6 [link] \"Forgot password?\"\n```\n\nFor unstructured reading (no refs needed):\n\n```bash\nagent-browser read                         # read rendered active-tab DOM\nagent-browser read https://docs.example.com/guide  # docs-friendly fetch, prefers markdown\nagent-browser read https://docs.example.com/guide --filter auth  # one matching section\nagent-browser read https://docs.example.com/guide --outline  # compact page headings\nagent-browser read https://docs.example.com --llms index --filter auth  # compact llms.txt discovery\nagent-browser get text @e1                # visible text of an element\nagent-browser get html @e1                # innerHTML\nagent-browser get attr @e1 href           # any attribute\nagent-browser get value @e1               # input value\nagent-browser get title                   # page title\nagent-browser get url                     # current URL\nagent-browser get count \".item\"           # count matching elements\n```\n\nUse `read [url]` when you need to consume documentation or other text pages rather than interact with a rendered UI. Omit the URL to read the rendered DOM of the active tab in the current browser session, including browser auth state and client-side updates. Explicit URL reads send `Accept: text/markdown`, try the same URL with `.md` appended when the first response is not markdown, walk ancestor paths toward `/` to find the nearest `llms.txt` for a matching docs link, print markdown/plain text when available, and fall back to readable text extracted from HTML without launching Chrome. Add `--filter <text>` to narrow a page to matching heading sections, `--outline` for compact headings on one page, `--llms index` for a compact nearest-ancestor `llms.txt` link list, and `--llms full` only when you explicitly need `llms-full.txt`. With `--llms` or `--require-md`, omitting the URL uses the active tab URL because those modes depend on HTTP resources. With `--llms` or `--outline`, `--filter <text>` narrows links, sections, or headings. Add `--require-md` when you specifically want to verify markdown negotiation, `--raw` when you need the response body unchanged, and `--json` when you need metadata such as `source` and `contentType`. Global safeguards such as `--allowed-domains`, `--content-boundaries`, and `--max-output` also apply to read fetches and output.\n\nFor sessions that handle sensitive data, use `--allowed-domains` to restrict navigations and page-initiated network traffic. Supported Chromium sessions also disable `RTCPeerConnection` while the allowlist is active so WebRTC STUN, TURN, and related DNS traffic cannot bypass the HTTP filter. Dedicated and shared workers are guarded with a bootstrap wrapper; if a page CSP forbids that wrapper, the worker fails closed rather than running without the allowlist guard. Pre-existing CDP sessions, auto-connect, Chrome profiles, direct-page provider plugins, agent-browser restore or state-file replay, raw Chrome args that select profiles, restore sessions, or open startup pages, iOS, and Safari reject this option because agent-browser cannot install equivalent containment before page scripts run. This is browser-level containment, not an operating-system firewall; see [Trust boundaries](references/trust-boundaries.md) for deployment guidance.\n\n## Interacting\n\n```bash\nagent-browser click @e1                   # click\nagent-browser click @e1 --new-tab         # open link in new tab instead of navigating\nagent-browser dblclick @e1                # double-click\nagent-browser hover @e1                   # hover\nagent-browser focus @e1                   # focus (useful before keyboard input)\nagent-browser fill @e2 \"hello\"            # clear then type\nagent-browser type @e2 \" world\"           # type without clearing\nagent-browser press Enter                 # press a key at current focus\nagent-browser press Control+a             # key combination\nagent-browser check @e3                   # check checkbox\nagent-browser uncheck @e3                 # uncheck\nagent-browser select @e4 \"option-value\"   # select dropdown option\nagent-browser select @e4 \"a\" \"b\"          # select multiple\nagent-browser upload @e5 file1.pdf        # upload file(s)\nagent-browser scroll down 500             # scroll page (up/down/left/right)\nagent-browser scrollintoview @e1          # scroll element into view\nagent-browser drag @e1 @e2                # drag and drop\n```\n\n### When refs don't work or you don't want to snapshot\n\nUse semantic locators:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser find role button click --name \"Submit\"\nagent-browser find role heading text --name \"Skills\"     #

  3. 在请求详情确认业务字段更新
  4. 进入 Settings > Workflows > Execution records 打开 run #1 并逐个检查节点

  4. Register acceptance 节点 Succeeded，结果 urgent:false、requestId 1、title Third-floor printer is offline
  5. Evaluate urgency 返回 false；Record normal result Succeeded；Record urgent result Not executed

  4. 刷新页面后仍为 1 unread，该消息仍为 Mark unread（已读状态持久）
